svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1432 commits across five public projects, 76 active days, peak 207 commits per day. 2026-07-18 through 2026-10-09 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-09T06:00:04.532Z.
